# ae.wait.hk - Hong Kong Hospital Accident & Emergency Waiting Times

> This website provides real-time estimated waiting times for Accident & Emergency departments across Hong Kong hospitals. It specializes in displaying wait times for semi-urgent (Category IV) and non-urgent (Category V) cases, which often have longer waiting periods. The site enhances the official data with advanced filtering, sorting, and detailed hospital insights to help users make informed decisions.

## About This Service

This service, ae.wait.hk, is an independent improvement upon the original Hospital Authority (HA) waiting time display. It aims to offer a more user-friendly and informative experience for individuals seeking Accident & Emergency waiting times in Hong Kong.
The data is retrieved from the official open data platform data.gov.hk  via the Hospital Authority's API . Our transformed API endpoint is available at [https://ae.wait.hk/api/waits].
The waiting time information is updated approximately every 15 minutes.

## Key Features and Differences

Unlike the original source, ae.wait.hk focuses specifically on estimated waiting times for patients triaged into **Category IV (Semi-Urgent)** and **Category V (Non-Urgent)** cases, which typically experience longer waits. We also provide visual indicators (icons) to show if a hospital is currently managing critical (Category I) or emergency (Category II) cases, which suggests potential increases in waiting times for lower priority categories.

Here are the unique features offered by ae.wait.hk:
*   **Region-based Filtering:** Users can filter hospitals by geographical region.
*   **Critical Case Management Filter:** Option to filter out hospitals that are not currently managing any critical cases.
*   **Advanced Sorting:** Hospitals can be sorted by name, region, and various waiting time metrics.
*   **Multi-Locale Support:** The site is available in English, Traditional Chinese, and Simplified Chinese.

## Transformed API Data Structure

The API endpoint `https://ae.wait.hk/api/waits` returns data in a structured JSON format. Understanding this structure is crucial for accurate data interpretation. Below are the TypeScript interfaces that define the shape of the API response:

```typescript
export interface TransformedHospitalData {
    // The full name of the hospital.
    hospitalName: string
    // A short acronym for the hospital, e.g., "AHMLNH".
    hospitalSlug: string // Represents HospitalAcronym
    // Indicates if the hospital is managing critical (Category I) cases.
    // Possible values: "MANAGING", "NOT_MANAGING".
    criticalManagementStatus: "MANAGING" | "NOT_MANAGING" // Represents ManagementStatus
    // Indicates if the hospital is managing emergency (Category II) cases.
    // Possible values: "MANAGING", "NOT_MANAGING".
    emergencyManagementStatus: "MANAGING" | "NOT_MANAGING" // Represents ManagementStatus
    // An object containing various waiting time metrics in minutes.
    waitTimes: {
        // Waiting time for critical (Category I) cases in minutes. Can be null if not applicable.
        criticalMinutes: number | null
        // Waiting time for emergency (Category II) cases in minutes. Can be null if not applicable.
        emergencyMinutes: number | null
        // 50th percentile waiting time for urgent (Category III) cases in minutes.
        urgentP50Minutes: number | null
        // 95th percentile waiting time for urgent (Category III) cases in minutes.
        urgentP95Minutes: number | null
        // 50th percentile waiting time for semi-urgent (Category IV) and non-urgent (Category V) cases in minutes.
        semiUrgentNonUrgentP50Minutes: number | null
        // 95th percentile waiting time for semi-urgent (Category IV) and non-urgent (Category V) cases in minutes.
        semiUrgentNonUrgentP95Minutes: number | null
    }
}

export interface ApiResponse {
    // The timestamp when the data was last updated, in "DD/MM/YYYY HH:MM AM/PM" format.
    lastUpdated: string
    // An array of TransformedHospitalData objects, each representing a hospital's waiting times.
    waitTimes: TransformedHospitalData[]
}
```

**Explanation of Fields:**

*   `lastUpdated`: A string indicating the timestamp of the last data update.
*   `waitTimes`: An array where each element (`TransformedHospitalData`) represents a specific hospital.
    *   `hospitalName`: The full name of the hospital.
    *   `hospitalSlug`: A unique, short identifier for the hospital.
    *   `criticalManagementStatus`: Status indicating if the hospital is actively managing critical (Category I) cases.
    *   `emergencyManagementStatus`: Status indicating if the hospital is actively managing emergency (Category II) cases.
    *   `waitTimes` (nested object): Contains detailed waiting time metrics for different triage categories:
        *   `criticalMinutes`: Waiting time for Category I cases.
        *   `emergencyMinutes`: Waiting time for Category II cases.
        *   `urgentP50Minutes`: 50th percentile waiting time for Category III (Urgent) cases.
        *   `urgentP95Minutes`: 95th percentile waiting time for Category III (Urgent) cases.
        *   `semiUrgentNonUrgentP50Minutes`: 50th percentile waiting time for Category IV (Semi-Urgent) and Category V (Non-Urgent) cases combined.
        *   `semiUrgentNonUrgentP95Minutes`: 95th percentile waiting time for Category IV (Semi-Urgent) and Category V (Non-Urgent) cases combined.
        *   *Note: `null` values indicate that data for that specific category or percentile might not be available or applicable at the moment.*

## How to Access Detailed Hospital Information

To get comprehensive details about a specific hospital, users can click on any hospital record in the main table. This action opens a side panel with the following information:
*   **Live vs. Average Wait Time:** A comparison of the current waiting time against the average trend for the current day and hour.
*   **Hourly Trend Graph:** A graph illustrating the waiting time trends hour-by-hour for the current day. Users can also select different days (Monday to Sunday) to view historical waiting time trends for all 24 hours of those days.
*   **Hospital Contact and Location:** Includes the hospital's Google Maps location, phone number, fax, email, official website (if available), and its profile on the Hospital Authority website.
